Markets.title: Market wrap: Axis Bank, Asian Paints, Max Healthcare, Infosys top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian benchmark indices Nifty 50 and Sensex closed higher on Friday by 0.34% and 0.43% respectively. Axis Bank and Asian Paints led the gains, while Max Healthcare and Infosys were among the top losers.

Markets.title: Embassy REIT raises Rs 1,000 cr via debentures to refinance debt
Markets.summary: Embassy Office Parks REIT raised Rs 1,000 crore through non-convertible debentures fully subscribed by a European bank. The company will use the funds to refinance existing debt and strengthen its financial position.

Markets.title: India bonds slide for sixth week as global rout deepens
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds fell for a sixth consecutive week due to rising global borrowing rates and soaring oil prices. Despite these pressures, robust liquidity has helped the bonds remain surprisingly resilient as investors anticipate a potential interest rate hike.

Markets.title: NSE’s D-Street Debut Makes It 6th Most Valuable Exchange. What’s ahead?
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange's debut on Dalal Street made it the world's sixth most valuable exchange. The milestone raises questions about its future market performance and regulatory outlook.

Markets.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit 2.0: Structured debt and the search for higher yields
Markets.summary: High-net-worth individuals are increasingly turning to structured debt for better returns and risk management. While these investments offer downside protection through collateral and capital structure, liquidity concerns remain an issue.

Geo-Political.summary: During his UN General Assembly speech, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended his country's military actions. He labeled the delegates who walked out before his address as "moral cowards."

Data & Insights.title: India-Australia trade pact: CECA, BIT talks to deepen ties in critical minerals, investment
Data & Insights.summary: India and Australia are negotiating a broader Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement and a bilateral investment treaty. These talks focus on critical minerals, investment, education, and talent to deepen bilateral ties.

Data & Insights.title: Cabinet to soon decide on new bilateral investment treaty template to ease dispute settlements
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian Cabinet will soon vote on a new bilateral investment treaty template designed to simplify dispute settlements. The updated model will significantly reduce the current five-year mandatory litigation period required before companies can seek global arbitration.

Data & Insights.title: India-Mexico may sign trade pact, report reveals: Autos, pharma, engineering—who stands to gain?
Data & Insights.summary: India and Mexico plan to finalize terms for a preferential trade agreement in early October to boost trade and market access. The agreement could increase Indian exports in the automotive, pharmaceutical, and engineering sectors despite upcoming import tariffs.

Data & Insights.title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund loans cross  ₹1 trillion as Centre targets post-harvest efficiency
Data & Insights.summary: Loans under the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund have surpassed ₹1 trillion to improve post-harvest efficiency. Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, and Gujarat are the top five beneficiary states, with individual farmers accounting for nearly 59% of approved projects.

Data & Insights.title: Centre cuts import duty on edible oils to curb price rise
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has reduced import duties on edible oils. This reduction aims to lower cooking oil costs and provide price relief to consumers.

Data & Insights.title: PM’s principal secretary flags risks from trade barriers, volatile capital
Data & Insights.summary: India's principal secretary Pramod Kumar Mishra warned that the country cannot depend on favorable global conditions despite its economic stability and growth. He specifically highlighted potential risks from international trade barriers and volatile capital flows.

India.title: Woman Couldn't Walk, Her Son Stayed To Save Her. Both Died In Noida Bus Fire
India.summary: Sunita and Shashank, the wife and son of a local BJP official, died in a bus fire in Noida. The mother could not walk, and her son stayed behind with her inside the burning vehicle.

India.title: Cop Shot Dead Inside Chandigarh Home, Son Detained
India.summary: An Indian police officer was shot and killed inside his Chandigarh home following an argument. Police have detained the officer's son, Armaan, for allegedly firing the fatal shots.

India.title: Man's Crowdfunding Drive For Sister's Surgery Went Viral. She Doesn't Exist
India.summary: Indian police arrested Ajayveer Singh for running a viral crowdfunding campaign on X where he faked the identity of a 16-year-old boy. Singh solicited donations for a non-existent sister's fictitious eye surgery.

India.title: Seva First Innovation Challenge 2026: Education Minister Launches Registration Portal At IISc Bengaluru
India.summary: Union Education Minister Pralhad Joshi launched the Seva First Innovation Challenge 2026 website on September 25. The launch took place at IISc Bengaluru to open the event's registration portal.

India.title: "Stalin Sir, Open Your Mouth": Vijay Attacks DMK In Veeramani Sex Abuse Case
India.summary: Actor Vijay criticized the DMK government and Chief Minister M.K. Stalin for allegedly burying a sexual abuse complaint filed against Veeramani during a previous DMK regime. He demanded that Stalin publicly address the case.

India.title: On Camera, Speeding Car Rams 6 Vehicles In Punjab, Biker Flung Into Air
India.summary: A speeding car collided with six vehicles in Punjab, injuring five people and flinging a biker into the air. Police have taken action against the driver, and the injured individuals have been hospitalised.

General.title: Noah Woods left playground through gap in fence, inquest hears
General.summary: Noah Woods died after leaving a playground through a gap in the fence, an inquest has heard. Following the tragedy, his mother urged parents to hold their children tightly and cherish every moment.

General.title: Daniel Thomas pleads not guilty after dinghy slashed
General.summary: Daniel Thomas pleaded not guilty to criminal damage charges. The accusation follows a video that reportedly shows him slashing a dinghy.

General.title: Some BBC channels and radio stations may well have to close, director general says
General.summary: BBC Director General Matt Brittin states that the broadcaster's financial situation may force some channels and radio stations to close. These potential closures are a direct result of the BBC's ongoing financial pressures.

General.title: NHS to suspend staff suspected of snooping on patient records
General.summary: The head of the NHS in England announced that staff suspected of snooping on patient records will be suspended. This decision comes in response to too many cases of workers abusing patient trust.

General.title: Just how hot and dry was your summer? Use our postcode lookup to find out
General.summary: While most regions experienced summer heatwaves and drought, temperatures and rainfall varied significantly by location. A new postcode lookup tool allows residents to check the specific weather conditions in their local area.
